messages:
alex.newhire: Hey all, following the quickstart for the starter-cloudflare-worker sample and hitting TS errors when bundling for the Edge. Fresh install, Node 18, pnpm. Error says our generic overloads don't match and there's a mysterious 'any' leak.

sam.sdk: can you paste the exact compiler output?

alex.newhire: sure: 
```
error TS2345: Argument of type 'unknown' is not assignable to parameter of type 'string'.
src/entry.ts:8:17 - error TS2769: No overload matches this call.
8   const out = Redwood.generate({ prompt });
                  ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
```
I've got tsconfig: { module: 'ESNext', moduleResolution: 'bundler', target: 'ES2022' } and package.json has "type": "module". Works if I switch to moduleResolution: 'nodenext' locally though.

neha.types: two axes here: a) Edge bundlers (esbuild/webpack used by CF) resolve imports and type roots differently under bundler vs nodenext, and b) our typings include a wide generic overload that accepts T and returns T | any which confuses inference when input is unknown.

oliver.runtime: +1. Also Cloudflare's worker runtime compiles with a different resolution map; it may load the CJS entry if we ship both. That flips how TS applies overload selection in some cases.

sam.sdk: quick mitigation for the starter: change the sample import to `import * as Redwood from '@redwood/inference'` or call the narrower overload explicitly like `Redwood.generate<string>({ prompt })`. Both should compile.

alex.newhire: import * as Redwood worked for me, thank you. Would it be safe to document that in the quickstart?

neha.types: document it and add a short note in troubleshooting. Longer term we should: 1) narrow the polymorphic overload to `T extends Record<string, unknown>`, 2) ensure our published package has explicit cjs -> esm shims so bundlers pick the intended entry, and 3) add a tsc compile job in sample CI that runs with both 'bundler' and 'nodenext' configurations.

sam.sdk: agreed. I'll open an SDK PR that changes the typings and adds a compatibility build output (index.cjs that re-exports default). It'll include tests to assert `tsc --noEmit` passes for both tsconfig shapes.

ci-bot: job queued: sample/ts-compat-matrix (nodenext,bundler) :hourglass_flowing_sand:

oliver.runtime: also consider shipping a small runtime note in the package README: "If you target Edge platforms, prefer `import * as` or pin moduleResolution until SDK patch lands." Keeps new users unblocked.

alex.newhire: appreciate the quick responses. This was blocking me for onboarding tasks. Will keep an eye on the PR and update the sample README in the meantime.

sam.sdk: PR draft coming shortly; assigning reviewers @neha.types and @oliver.runtime.

neha.types: thanks — will review the overload change carefully to avoid regressing ergonomics for the common string-prompt case.

ci-bot: sample/ts-compat-matrix finished 44d (0 failures)

sam.sdk: CI green for the compile matrix. Opening PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/358 (typings + cjs shim + sample README note).

alex.newhire: confirmed starter works after `import * as Redwood` update. thanks team! :tada:
